name: Dragon Knight
pitch: A kind young knight-in-training sets out to meet the dragon everyone is afraid of and discovers it is just shy and lonely.
setting: The Kingdom of Applebright, with a hilltop castle, patchwork fields, a misty mountain, and a cave full of glittering crystals

supportingCast.name: Sir Bramble

supportingCast.name: Hazel
supportingCast.look: fluffy chestnut pony with a braided mane and ribbons
